response.justification: While Szabo brings exceptional technical depth (20 years of experience, Staff-level positions, strong testing and developer tools expertise), he completely lacks the critical requirement of 2 years in people management—zero formal management experience is documented. The role explicitly requires full-time people-leadership responsibilities including conducting 1-on-1s, performance management, and talent development. His background is entirely individual-contributor, making this a fundamental misalignment despite strong technical credentials.
strengths: Exceptional technical breadth and depth across 20 years with Staff-level positions and mastery of multiple languages, systems, and domains
Strong focus on testing infrastructure and code quality, evidenced by creating testing libraries (Fluent-Asserts, Trial) and demonstrated TDD advocacy
Proven knowledge-sharing and mentoring ability through open-source projects, workshops, and teaching experience (Selenium course, Web Internals workshop)
concerns: Zero years of people management experience, completely missing the required 2-year minimum for a full-time people-leadership role
Career-long individual-contributor track record with no evidence of team leadership, performance management, or organizational change experience
No documented experience conducting performance reviews, 1-on-1s, or developing talent—core responsibilities of the role

key_factors.factor: Strong technical expertise in testing and developer tools
